from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import Literal, Optional

class DocumentRecord(BaseModel):
    """Extracted information from a single judgment document for classification."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of the judgment document")
    matched_category: Optional[Literal['执行案由 - 先予执行', '适用特殊程序案件案由', '行政行为 - 行政征收', '产品责任纠纷', '行政行为 - 行政处罚', '人格权纠纷']] = Field(description="One of the 6 specified cause-of-action categories if the document matches; otherwise null")
    case_description: str | None = Field(description="Brief description of the legal matter in the document to support classification")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[DocumentRecord]
